NocoDB 2026.08.1 brings major collaboration upgrades. 🚀

Realtime Presence lets you see live cursors in Grid view and jump directly to colleagues' edits. You can also freeze multiple fields, organize workspaces with Folders, and use nested records for hierarchical data.

Update available soon.

Release: https://github.com/nocodb/nocodb/releases/tag/2026.08.1
PikaPods: https://pikapods.com/pods?run=nocodb
